_meta.description: Progression history of player stat snapshots, recorded by scripts/record_stat_snapshot.py. 'base' snapshots capture OVR plus the six Summary-tab stats (Pace/Shooting/Passing/Dribbling/Defending/Physical) from a monthly base-card screenshot round. 'full' snapshots capture every detailed attribute column from wrexham_squad.csv / youth_academy.csv, taken at winter transfer window close (Jan 31) and at season start/rollover.
